issues.detail: The Chinese adds '作為我與會眾之間的證據' (as evidence between me and the assembly), but the Hebrew says 'תִּהְיֶה לִּי לְעֵדָה' (it shall be for me as a witness/evidence), without mentioning '會眾' (assembly). The addition of '與會眾之間' (between me and the assembly) introduces a concept not present in the Hebrew.
